project_tracker_diagnostic: Perennial from a branching caudex; leaves concentrated at the base; long mostly leafless peduncles each bear a yellow head; pappus consists of 5–7 aristate scales.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common, conspicuous, or high-value comparison species for Central Texas field ID.

morphology_keys.habit: Low rosette-forming plant with 1–many erect flowering stalks.
morphology_keys.leaves: Mostly basal/proximal, linear to oblanceolate or spatulate, entire or rarely toothed/lobed, often gland-dotted.
morphology_keys.heads: Yellow rays and yellow discs, usually one head per long peduncle.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Outer phyllaries 8–16; inner series shorter and more numerous.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
